acceptance_criteria.description: Cutover preflight detects legacy or mixed truth state, including old `prd/`, `user-story/`, `qa/test-cases/` surfaces, missing feature package files, missing governance MD, missing projection, and stale agent-surface guidance.
`beacon-change-refreeze` must detect legacy/mixed state before refreeze and route to cutover instead of presenting `beacon change ... --refreeze-chain` as sufficient.

Beacon exposes a human-facing one-command cutover wrapper that runs or reports phases: inventory, package materialize/validate, truth-map verify, governance verify/projection, agent-surface refresh, and resume.
Requirement package cutover must validate `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md` as v1.5.2 package authority; legacy triptych can be absorb/rebuild/archive-only and cannot win authority.
Project governance cutover must verify `docs/beacon/governance/project-version-governance.md` and generated sqlite/runtime projection, failing closed on missing version contract or projection drift.
Cutover must detect stale installed/project skills or agent rules that still present old triptych as normal v1.5.2 truth authority and route to `doctor setup-agent-surface` / verify.
Freeze, refreeze, implement, QA, and release must fail closed while package authority, governance MD, or agent-surface verification is incomplete or contradictory.
After successful cutover, Beacon resumes the original operator intent, such as refreeze, without requiring the operator to rediscover the next command.

For v1.5.2 package-authoritative features, `beacon implement plan` must consume `features/<slug>/tasks.md` as the requirement-owned task intent and may return a draft/skeleton plan even when execution admission is blocked; implementation progress must write to execution/progress artifacts, not mutate `tasks.md` checkbox state.

Beacon must close the four accepted friction findings with the lowest-cognitive-load route: keep `truth-cutover` as a CLI/machine repair transaction instead of adding a new default public skill, route existing human surfaces to it, add explicit `doctor truth-source-mismatch` diagnostics and repair commands, and regression-test the `technical_review_contract` root fix plus change CLI version stability.

test_rows.assertion: A project with legacy triptych, missing package, missing governance MD, missing projection, or stale agent surface is classified as `legacy_or_mixed_truth_state`.
`beacon-change-refreeze` blocks direct refreeze and recommends the cutover route when preflight reports legacy/mixed state.
The cutover wrapper emits ordered phases and can run/report inventory, package validation, truth-map verify, governance verify, agent refresh, and resume state.
Package validation treats `features/<slug>/truth.md` and `tests.md` as authority; legacy triptych conflicts are reported as drift with package truth winning.
`doctor metadata verify` fails closed when governance MD is missing, active version contract is missing, or sqlite projection source hash drifts.
Stale skills/rules that describe old triptych as normal v1.5.2 authority are detected and route to agent-surface setup/verify.
freeze/refreeze/implement/QA/release cannot pass while any cutover plane is blocked or contradictory.
After all cutover phases pass, the transaction returns the original requested route, including `beacon change ... --refreeze-chain` for refreeze intent.
Inventory mode is read-only and does not mutate package, governance MD, sqlite projection, or agent surface files.
A dry-run cutover report includes exact next commands for every blocked phase.
`beacon implement plan` resolves package `tasks.md` and reports task alignment even when technical review blocks execution admission.
Implementation progress updates execution plan/progress artifacts and does not write completion state back into `features/<slug>/tasks.md`.

No standalone default `beacon-truth-cutover` public skill is required; `beacon truth-cutover --help` is available and legacy/mixed preflight routes existing human surfaces to `beacon-truth-cutover` / `truth-cutover run`.

Doctor reports `truth_source_mismatch` with low-cognitive-load explanation and exact repair commands when feature package authority, truth-map projection, machine mirrors, governance, or legacy triptych contradict v1.5.2 authority.
`technical_review_contract` and `beacon change` accept relative `--project .` without subpath or version drift; `--version v1.5.2` remains the selected and recommended refreeze version.

task_rows.title: Add cutover inventory classification for legacy/mixed truth state.
Teach `beacon-change-refreeze` to run cutover preflight before refreeze.
Add a human-facing cutover wrapper command/skill for phased migration.
Wire package materialize/validate and truth-map verify into cutover phases.
Wire governance MD verify/projection drift checks into cutover phases.
Detect stale agent-surface skill guidance and route setup/verify.
Enforce fail-closed behavior for freeze/refreeze/implement/QA/release while cutover is blocked.
Preserve and resume the original operator intent after successful cutover.
Add tests for read-only inventory and dry-run next-command reporting.
Update skill guidance so research promotion goes through change/refreeze and not direct truth edits.
Align `beacon implement plan` with package `tasks.md` while keeping runtime progress in execution artifacts.
Add doctor `truth_source_mismatch` diagnostics with exact repair routing.
Add QA regressions for truth-cutover routing simplification, root normalization, and change CLI version stability.
Update help/doctor route copy so `truth-cutover` is presented as a CLI repair transaction, not a new default public skill.
